title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：summer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 summer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the farmer ① spent the summer that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the spending was the whole of the autumn. The ② summer, meaning the season itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a summer, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ summer in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ summer at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A summer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the summer was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the season. The ⑥ summer, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; summer, he said, is either something you spend or the only word that means both a season and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ summer had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ summer of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; summer, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ summer I remember is the season recorded in the almanac, which closed in 1970 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ summer, my mother said in 1972, is the only season that improves by being recorded; every summer, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a season. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 夏天（指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 夏天（指那个夏天本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：spend the summer 过这一个夏天
D. n. 夏天（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 夏天之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的夏天之事）
F. n. 夏天（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 夏天、暑气（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暑气（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: spent the summer that no child in the field would have recorded

answers.why: spend the summer 意为“过这一个夏天”，1963 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一个夏天做了一遍。
summer 意为“夏天”，指那个夏天本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
summer 意为“夏天”，指田垄里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
summer 意为“夏天”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
summer 意为“夏天、暑气”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个暑气就是那件事的全部。
summer 意为“暑气”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个夏天，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
summer 意为“夏天”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1968 年这一个成了农事历里的一行。
summer 意为“夏天之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的夏天之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
summer 意为“夏天”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一个，1970 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一个。
summer 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，夏天是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的夏天。
